definitions.explanation: Antisocial or illegal behavior, especially by young people.

examples.japanese: {少年|しょうねん}{非行|ひこう}が{社会|しゃかい}{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Juvenile delinquency has become a social problem.

examples.japanese: {非行|ひこう}に{走|はし}る{若者|わかもの}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More young people are turning to delinquency.

examples.japanese: {非行|ひこう}{防止|ぼうし}の{活動|かつどう}に{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: They are working on delinquency prevention activities.
examples.notes: {非行|ひこう}{防止|ぼうし} = delinquency prevention

examples.japanese: {非行|ひこう}{少年|しょうねん}を{更生|こうせい}させるための{施設|しせつ}がある。
examples.english: There are facilities for rehabilitating juvenile delinquents.
examples.notes: {非行|ひこう}{少年|しょうねん} = juvenile delinquent

examples.japanese: {家庭|かてい}{環境|かんきょう}が{非行|ひこう}の{原因|げんいん}の{一|ひと}つだと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that the home environment is one of the causes of delinquency.

notes:
Commonly used to refer to juvenile crime and antisocial behavior.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{少年|しょうねん}{非行|ひこう} (juvenile delinquency)
・{非行|ひこう}{少年|しょうねん} (juvenile delinquent)
・{非行|ひこう}に{走|はし}る (to turn to delinquency)
・{非行|ひこう}{防止|ぼうし} (delinquency prevention)
・{非行|ひこう}{グループ} (delinquent group)

HOMOPHONE:
・{飛行|ひこう} - flight, flying (aircraft)

NOTE:
The character {非|ひ} means "not" or "wrong," and {行|こう} means "conduct," so {非行|ひこう} literally means "wrong conduct."
